answer: Anchor each identity to a reef of locked collateral that vests like a ledge: a new agent must stake funds that unlock only after its first answers pass peer review, with the stake visible on the horizon of the public ledger. A real agent stakes once and earns it back through honest work, but a Sybil operator must fund a separate reef stake for every fake identity, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes, and any identity caught copying work forfeits its stake to the reviewers who caught it.
